payload.description:
# Headline pass runs after body HITL

## Intent

As a copy-editing agent, I want title and standfirst (subtitle/dek) treated as a **final** pass on the working copy, so the article can be titled after body edits have settled the piece's direction.

## Loop (body first)

1. `scan` body (YAML title/standfirst/description stay masked from body-prose rules).
2. Agent `decide` + `options` + `compare` + human pick + `apply` on a working copy.
3. Repeat body passes if the working copy still needs them.
4. **Then** headline: dedicated title + standfirst checks and rewrite options against the **current working copy**, not the original published file.
5. Apply headline patches only to the working copy. Original/published unchanged.

## Why last

Body rewrites can change what the piece is. Titling first, or in the same scan as body findings, locks a headline to an earlier draft.

## Done when

- First-pass `limatus scan` of a YAML article does **not** emit title/standfirst findings mixed into the body finding list.
- A later headline command or scan mode reads `title` and `standfirst` from the working copy and reports dedicated findings with spans in those YAML fields.
- Headline `options` rewrite only the title or standfirst value; YAML keys and fences stay intact.
- Apply still never writes `--original`.

## Out of scope

SEO `description` as a third field unless it is the on-page subtitle. Auto-titling without a human pick. Running headline checks during the first body scan.

```gherkin
Feature: Title the working copy last
  As a copy-editing agent
  I want title and standfirst checked only after body edits are applied
  So the headline matches the article we actually have

  Scenario: First scan ignores YAML title and standfirst as body prose
    Given a draft with YAML title and standfirst and a body that needs a rewrite
    When I run limatus scan
    Then the diagnosis has no title or standfirst findings
    And no cadence finding span lands inside the YAML block

  Scenario: Headline pass after a working-copy apply
    Given a working copy whose body has already been applied
    When I run the headline pass on that working copy
    Then findings cite the title and standfirst field values
    And applying a title option changes only the title line
    And the original draft is unchanged
```
payload.title: Title and standfirst after body HITL, not in the first scan
